visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an outdoor shot of a modern, white building with the logo 'MITSUI OUTLET PARK' under a bright, clear blue sky. A man and a woman in casual winter attire are seen walking toward the entrance. (2) A transition reveals the 'Jazz Dream Nagashima Resort' entrance sign, featuring colorful, playful lettering against a blue sky with bare trees in the foreground. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a green sign for 'Afternoon Tea LIVING' attached to a brick wall. (4) Inside the store, a man in a dark cardigan and a woman in a white turtleneck examine beige canvas tote bags hanging on a display rack. (5) The camera cuts to the exterior of a 'CHUMS' store with clothing displayed in the window, followed by a shot of a smiling woman in a bright yellow fleece jacket posing inside the store. (6) A detailed shot of a bowl of curry or stew featuring various vegetables like lotus root, green beans, and red peppers is shown on a wooden table. (7) A woman wearing a denim jacket and a dark baseball cap is shown eating the food with a spoon, followed by another woman in a white turtleneck smiling joyfully while eating. (8) A series of graphic slides appear with a pink and white background, detailing a lottery campaign with images of hotel vouchers, skincare sets, and shopping bags. (9) A screen recording shows scrolling through an Instagram profile with the handle @mitsuishoppingpark_tc, displaying various promotional posts. (10) Two women are shown walking through a brightly lit indoor mall corridor, smiling and carrying multiple shopping bags with the 'Francfranc' store visible in the background. The video ends with a shot of a large white airplane taking off over a MITSUI OUTLET PARK sign in Kobe.
